items.prompt: 邮件任务要求“拒绝邀请、说明原因并提出替代安排”。哪一项完整且得体？

choices.label: Thank you for the invitation. I am afraid I cannot attend because I will be away that day. Could we meet online the following week instead?
choices.why: 回应邀请、拒绝、原因和替代安排都完整，语气得体。

choices.label: I cannot come. The event is on Friday.
choices.why: 缺少清楚原因、礼貌表达和替代安排。

choices.label: Your invitation is wrong, so change the date for me.
choices.why: 语气生硬，也没有合理说明。

items.prompt: 图表显示线上支付从 35% 升到 68%，现金从 50% 降到 22%。哪句概括最准确？

choices.label: Online payment rose markedly while the share of cash payments fell by more than half.
choices.why: 同时准确概括了两个方向和现金降幅。

choices.label: Every consumer stopped using cash and moved online.
choices.why: 22% 仍使用现金，every 过度概括。

choices.label: Online and cash payments both increased at the same rate.

items.prompt: 立场是“城市不应只靠修更多道路解决拥堵”。哪组论证最有力？

choices.label: More roads may ease traffic briefly; however, they can encourage more driving. Reliable public transport addresses demand without requiring every trip to use a car.
choices.why: 先让步，再说明反作用，并给出与立场一致的替代方向。

choices.label: Roads are long, and cities are large. Traffic is a problem.
choices.why: 只有事实碎片，没有支持立场的因果链。

choices.label: Cars are bad because roads are bad, and roads are bad because cars are bad.
choices.why: 循环论证，没有独立理由。

items.prompt: 哪一句最适合接在“Remote work can widen access to jobs.”之后，再转向限制？

choices.label: People outside major cities may apply for roles that were once too far away. Nevertheless, unequal internet access remains a serious limit.
choices.why: 先展开 access，再用 nevertheless 转入相关限制。

choices.label: Major cities have many old buildings. Nevertheless, jobs are jobs.
choices.why: 信息与远程工作的机会、限制都不连贯。

choices.label: Remote work is remote because workers are not in the office.
choices.why: 同义反复，没有推进论证。

items.prompt: 哪一句最适合正式议论文，且没有把证据说得过头？

choices.label: The findings suggest that flexible schedules may improve retention in some workplaces.
choices.why: suggest、may 和 some 准确保留了证据边界。

choices.label: The findings prove that flexible schedules always solve every staffing problem.
choices.why: prove、always、every 都把有限证据绝对化。

choices.label: Flexible schedules are totally amazing for everybody.
choices.why: 口语化且绝对，没有学术准确性。
